description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Donnie & April
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Donnie & April
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
